entries.zh: 饱足、吃饱；吃腻、饱腻（hartarse：吃到饱、吃腻）
entries.en: satiated, full; to eat one's fill, to be fed up (hartarse)
satisfied, contented (satisfecho); pleased
bloated, stuffed full; gorged
fully satisfied and contented
full to satiety, replete

entries.zh: 吃伤而饱、吃撑伤身（食伤：过食致伤）
entries.en: to eat to excess so as to harm oneself; stuff oneself sick

entries.zh: 饱到食物顶到嘴边（食到喙/口），喻极饱
entries.en: so full that the food reaches one's mouth; stuffed to bursting
until, up to; as far as
entries.notes: 汉字'到'与西语 Hasta 互证清晰，但闽南语栏含两处 T99 污损音节、官话栏仅存 'M.' 标记，例证读音部分不可辨，故降为低置信。

entries.en: until, up to; to reach
until, up to
〔entry defective in the original, gloss uncertain〕
entries.notes: 汉字栏仅存破折号、闽南语栏空缺，官话栏 'vol noh.' 不可解；仅西语词头 hasta allí（直到那里）可读，证据不足，按残缺件处理。

entries.en: until the end, to the utmost

entries.zh: 足够、够用（达到过活所需）
entries.en: enough, sufficient; up to what is needed to get by
up to what one can eat; enough to live on
sufficient food, enough to eat

entries.zh: 到能够过日子的程度、足以度日
entries.en: enough to get through the days, to make a living
until now, up to the present
to the very end, to the utmost
in the end, at last; until the very end

entries.zh: 到底、直到底部（深处）；亦引申作'到底/终究'
entries.en: to the bottom, to the depths; also 'to the end, in the end'

entries.zh: 畢、到头；甚至任何东西都（至极之辞）
entries.en: to the very end of anything, even of any thing; wholly, finished
entries.notes: 汉字'畢'与音写 cûa（kuà）音不合（'畢'当为 pit 类音），西语例词 randa、acada 及缩写 &a 未能确解，依汉字与西语词头取义，降为中置信。
